note: Research entries aligned to the 11-category CTI taxonomy. Original topic labels retained as secondary topics. Source metadata is not universally verified; review_status flags uncertainty.

resources.author: Canadian Securities Administrators
resources.title: Project Tokenization: Phase 1 Findings Report
resources.summary: Examines tokenized capital markets, ownership, custody, interoperability and regulatory considerations.
resources.cti_relevance: Shows why tokenization alone does not establish enforceable rights, accountable governance or trustworthy data.

resources.author: World Bank
resources.title: FundsChain: blockchain-based development finance infrastructure
resources.summary: Explores traceability and documentation of development funding through digital infrastructure.
resources.cti_relevance: A comparative example for evidence provenance, accountability and transparency in capital flows.

resources.author: Hong Kong Monetary Authority
resources.title: Project Ensemble: tokenized settlement developments
resources.summary: Describes developments in tokenized financial infrastructure and settlement.
resources.cti_relevance: Useful comparison for sovereign settlement optionality and institutional coordination.

resources.author: W3C
resources.title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0
resources.summary: Defines a standard data model for verifiable credentials and claims.
resources.cti_relevance: Offers a standards-based reference for portable attestations, without requiring a specific blockchain.

resources.author: W3C
resources.title: Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0
resources.summary: Defines decentralized identifiers and their associated verification methods.
resources.cti_relevance: Relevant to identity portability and interoperable verification of actors and claims.

resources.author: Skateistan
resources.title: Skateboarding and the Olympics: Initial Results
resources.summary: Early research exploring the relationship between skateboarding, Olympic participation and community sport.
resources.cti_relevance: Relevant to how community sport value is understood beyond elite performance metrics.

resources.author: Payments Canada
resources.title: Canada's Real-Time Rail launch confirmed in Budget 2026
resources.summary: An update on Canada's domestic real-time payment infrastructure.
resources.cti_relevance: Supports consideration of Canadian-dollar settlement and technology-neutral trust systems.

resources.author: Wells Fargo Newsroom
resources.title: International financial institutions establish stablecoin enterprise
resources.summary: Announces a collaborative institutional stablecoin initiative.
resources.cti_relevance: Raises questions about governance, settlement sovereignty and cross-border interoperability.

resources.author: World Bank
resources.title: FundsChain documentation: implementation resources
resources.summary: Documentation related to the FundsChain initiative and its development-finance workflows.
resources.cti_relevance: Useful for comparing institutional evidence trails with community-generated signals and attestations.

resources.author: World Bank
resources.title: FundsChain documentation: case resources
resources.summary: Additional published documentation associated with the FundsChain initiative.
resources.cti_relevance: Provides implementation context for accountable capital distribution and reporting.

resources.author: BIS (author details pending verification)
resources.title: Hidden by complexity? Measuring stablecoin, crypto and decentralised finance ecosystems
resources.summary: Working-paper reference in the CTI research register concerning the interpretation and measurement of on-chain activity; exact bibliographic details need confirmation.
resources.cti_relevance: Technical verifiability does not imply valid inference. CTI must distinguish captured signals from interpreted and validated evidence.
resources.review_status: exact paper link and authors unverified; links to BIS publications directory

resources.author: Michał Moneta
resources.title: Stablecoin Adoption in Emerging Markets: A TAM-Based Model of Digital Finance Use
resources.summary: A conceptual synthesis of 73 sources proposing seven determinants and nine propositions about adoption, including trust, literacy, infrastructure and the intention–use gap; not a causal empirical test.
resources.cti_relevance: Demonstrates why a payment rail's technical availability is not evidence of usability, local acceptance or sustained participation.

resources.author: KPMG Canada
resources.title: The strategic role of stablecoins and tokenization for Canadian institutions
resources.summary: Reviews institutional tokenization, stablecoin use cases and regulatory questions; reports that roughly 99.7% of stablecoins are USD-denominated.
resources.cti_relevance: Provides a monetary-sovereignty context for CTI's settlement-agnostic approach, without confusing monetary representation with trust validation.

resources.author: Chainalysis
resources.title: North America: Inside the Growth of Agentic Commerce
resources.summary: Analyzes regional crypto activity, dollar stablecoins, Canadian cross-border remittances and emerging agent-initiated payments; methodology and vendor interests should be considered.
resources.cti_relevance: Raises the distinction between authorizing a machine to execute a transaction and having valid evidence to justify that transaction.

resources.author: Chainalysis
resources.title: 2026 Global Crypto Adoption Index
resources.summary: Introduces an adoption measurement approach incorporating services, peer-to-peer flows, cross-border activity and balances; rankings are methodology-dependent.
resources.cti_relevance: A useful comparator for differentiating activity metrics from evidence of locally meaningful benefit or legitimate decision-making.

resources.author: Iñaki Aldasoro, Jon Frost and Hiro Ito
resources.title: The impact of stablecoins on the international monetary and financial system
resources.summary: BIS Paper 170 examines potential monetary-system effects of stablecoins and scenarios involving digital dollarization and domestic stablecoin integration.
resources.cti_relevance: Supports explicit separation of trust infrastructure from currency choice, settlement systems and monetary-policy autonomy.

resources.author: Circle
resources.title: Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol (CCTP)
resources.summary: Documentation for moving native USDC between supported networks through burn-and-mint workflows; this is product documentation rather than independent evidence of outcomes.
resources.cti_relevance: Illustrates value interoperability while leaving claim validation, governance legitimacy and allocation decisions outside the transfer mechanism.

resources.author: ENS DAO
resources.title: ENS DAO governance
resources.summary: Governance documentation for ENS DAO and its organizational decision structures; not a substitute for analysis of individual 2026 votes.
resources.cti_relevance: A comparator for delegated execution, explicit authority boundaries and accountability to a broader governing community.

resources.author: UNICEF Office of Innovation
resources.title: FemTech Innovation Call
resources.summary: UNICEF's innovation call focused on technology addressing needs and barriers affecting women and girls; a program announcement, not outcome research.
resources.cti_relevance: A potential institutional reference for ethical technology design, inclusion and careful evidence standards in vulnerable settings.

resources.author: Kotani Pay
resources.title: Kotani Pay: local payment and off-ramp infrastructure
resources.summary: Provider overview of digital asset and local-currency payment infrastructure. This is a vendor source and does not independently establish impact.
resources.cti_relevance: Highlights that settlement and cash-out availability depend on local institutions and relationships, beyond on-chain transfer finality.

resources.author: Payments Canada
resources.title: Real-Time Rail infrastructure and modernization
resources.summary: Payments Canada's official site provides information about national payments modernization and domestic settlement infrastructure; link is to the institution, not a specific report.
resources.cti_relevance: Relevant to Canadian settlement optionality and the principle that CTI should not be coupled to one monetary or technical rail.
